Thanks for the context. I reviewed the Order Form and Ben’s redlines. High-level legal position: 24-month term + staged capacity is commercially acceptable; we should tighten a few points before sending to Elara counsel.

Key redline items:
1) Data residency / processing: Accept Ben’s proposed US-region processing limitation, but we need a carve for emergency cross-region processing for failover — retains customer control if they opt-out.
2) Indemnity cap: Elara requested a carve for subcontractor-supplied models — we should keep the standard MSA cap but add a specific carve for third-party licensed models limited to fees paid for those models.
3) Termination for convenience: Elara asked to shorten notice to 30 days — counter to our commercial risk posture. Recommend 90-day notice with pro-rated refunds for pre-paid credits.
4) Audit window: tighten the on-site audit window wording to require written notice and limit to once per 12 months, reasonable business hours.

I’ve tracked these in the attached PDF (Redwood_Response_Redlines_20270910.pdf) and highlighted the clauses we expect back from Elara. Suggest the 9/12 or 9/13 sync Ben proposed — we can join to walk through these items with Elara counsel.

Once Ben confirms the meeting time, I’ll prepare a short legal playbook with fallback positions so we keep to procurement’s 9/17 target.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference
